insight: Aim for 10k net worth at minute 20. Low MMR mid laners average 7-8k, which is significantly behind. Achieve this through consistent farming, not just kills.

insight: Push the lane to create approximately 20 seconds of free time before the next wave arrives. Use this window for pressure, farm, rotations, or rune contesting.

source.title: 11K Mid Explains How to 1v9 in ANY MMR BRACKET

insight: After pushing a wave, choose from four options: pressure the tower, farm nearby camps, rotate to other lanes, or contest runes. Evaluate conditions before each choice.

matchup_context: when ahead in levels or health
insight: Pressure the enemy mid laner when you have a significant advantage (level lead, health advantage). This denies them farm/experience and prevents rune contesting. Stop pressuring once they reach parity.

source.title: 11K Mid Explains How to 1v9 in ANY MMR BRACKET

insight: Never rotate before reaching level 6. Post-level 6, consider rotations based on hero type, rune availability, and map advantage.

source.title: 11K Mid Explains How to 1v9 in ANY MMR BRACKET

insight: Mobile heroes (Puck, Spirit Breaker, Ember Spirit, Pangolier) can rotate and farm easily. Immobile heroes (Viper, Shadow Fiend, Sniper, Lina, Outworld Destroyer) should farm and pressure until they buy mobility items like Boots of Travel or Blink Dagger.

source.title: 11K Mid Explains How to 1v9 in ANY MMR BRACKET

insight: Only rotate if: lane is pushed, absence won't exceed 40 seconds, you have resources (mana/HP/spells), and you have information advantage or a kill threat. Otherwise, farm.

source.title: 11K Mid Explains How to 1v9 in ANY MMR BRACKET

insight: Optimal rotation timers are minute 7 (Wisdom Rune), minute 10 (siege creep + Power Rune), and minute 15 (siege creep). Best rotations result in taking map control, not just kills.

source.title: 11K Mid Explains How to 1v9 in ANY MMR BRACKET

matchup_context: playing heroes like Viper, Lina, Shadow Fiend, Sniper
insight: Focus on farming to buy mobility items. Only rotate when enemy dives your lanes and a Teleport guarantees a kill, or when you secure a Haste Rune.

source.title: 11K Mid Explains How to 1v9 in ANY MMR BRACKET

insight: Contest every Power Rune if conditions allow: you have resources, no better objective available, and your hero can survive the fight. Avoid if spell cooldowns are critical or you lack HP/mana.

source.title: 11K Mid Explains How to 1v9 in ANY MMR BRACKET

insight: Minute 5 onwards becomes easier to pressure towers due to siege creeps. Use minute 10 and minute 15 siege waves with Power Runes to take Tier 1 towers, not Tier 2.

source.title: 11K Mid Explains How to 1v9 in ANY MMR BRACKET

insight: Spend 80% of the game farming. Farming is your default state. Only deviate for pressure, rotations, or runes. Hit nearby jungle camps when no mid lane opportunity exists.

source.title: 11K Mid Explains How to 1v9 in ANY MMR BRACKET

insight: During hero downtime (after large cooldowns expire), farm to scale instead of forcing fights. Example: Beast Master should farm after using Roar.

source.title: 11K Mid Explains How to 1v9 in ANY MMR BRACKET

insight: Mana is the critical resource. Runes significantly impact effectiveness. Farm to sustain mana regeneration between fights.

insight: Divide late game into objective timers: Runes (every 2 min), Siege creeps (every 5 min), Tormentor (20 min), Roshan. Prioritize Tormentor and Roshan over other farming.
